description: Extension of the ChannelsSettings class providing UI-related logic and status handling for various messaging channels within an app. Includes functions for determining tint colors, summaries, details, order, and error states based on different channel statuses, as well as helper functions for decoding channel information and generating UI components.

methods.name: channelStatus<T: Decodable>
methods.description: Generic method to retrieve and decode the status snapshot for a given channel ID.

methods.name: configuredChannelTint
methods.description: Determines the color tint for a channel based on configuration, error, and running state.

methods.name: configuredChannelSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary string indicating whether a channel is configured, running, or not configured.

methods.name: appendProbeDetails
methods.description: Appends various probe status details to a lines array for display.

methods.name: finishDetails
methods.description: Finalizes and returns a detailed string description for a channel's status, combining probe details.

methods.name: finishProbeDetails
methods.description: Wraps finishDetails for probe-specific status information.

methods.name: channelSection(_:)
methods.description: UI builder method to provide a view section for a specific channel.

methods.name: channelTint(_:)
methods.description: Returns a color representing the state of a channel based on its ID.

methods.name: channelSummary(_:)
methods.description: Returns a short summary string for a channel based on its status.

methods.name: channelDetails(_:)
methods.description: Returns a detailed status string for a channel, such as connection details or errors.

methods.name: channelLastCheckText(_:)
methods.description: Returns relative age string of last check timestamp for a channel.

methods.name: channelLastCheck(_:)
methods.description: Returns the last check Date object for the specified channel.

methods.name: channelHasError(_:)
methods.description: Determines if a channel currently has an error condition.

methods.name: resolveChannelTitle(_:)
methods.description: Resolves a human-readable title for a given channel ID.

methods.name: resolveChannelDetailTitle(_:)
methods.description: Resolves detailed label for a channel.

methods.name: resolveChannelSystemImage(_:)
methods.description: Gets the system image name associated with the channel.

methods.name: channelStatusDictionary(_:)
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of the channel's status info from the store snapshot.
